$comment: Independent target allow-lists (15 section 7, ADR-0017). calls assigns optional call-<target> scopes and internal.<target> roles to svc-<caller> for client credentials. exchange assigns optional exchange-<target> scopes to the exchange-only shp-api client, bound to the listed workload. User tokens carry only shp-api. Each target scope maps only svc-<target> into the issued access token.
